A practical guide to building reliable Angular applications with faster test execution, smarter tooling, and maintainable testing practices.

6 min read
Just now

--

Testing has always been a critical part of software development, but in 2026 it has become more important than ever. Angular applications are expected to deliver rich user experiences, support AI-powered features, and handle increasingly complex business logic. As applications grow, a single unnoticed bug can impact thousands of users. That is why testing is no longer just a quality assurance activity — it is an essential part of the development workflow.
The Angular ecosystem has also evolved significantly. Standalone components, Signals, zoneless change detection, and faster build tools have changed the way developers write and test applications. Modern testing is no longer about achieving 100% code coverage; it is about building confidence that the application behaves correctly under real-world conditions.
